vsql_sql: SELECT (SELECT AVG(y.Consumption) FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312') - (SELECT AVG(y.Consumption) FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312') AS difference_sme_lam, (SELECT AVG(y.Consumption) FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312') - (SELECT AVG(y.Consumption) FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312') AS difference_lam_kam, (SELECT AVG(y.Consumption) FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312') - (SELECT AVG(y.Consumption) FROM yearmonth y JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312') AS difference_kam_sme
